key.name: style
key.description: "glass": translucent, softly blurred surfaces with rounded shapes. "classic": calmer frosted surfaces, more opaque, with tighter corners.

key.name: folder-colour
key.description: Colour of folders and the trash in the ParchaOS icon theme. parchaos-theme-sync picks the matching dark or light icon theme.

key.name: restore-session
key.summary: Reopen apps when logging back in
key.description: Reopen the apps that were open at the end of the last session and put their windows back where they were.

key.name: focus-schedule
key.description: Turn on Do Not Disturb every day between focus-start and focus-end. A Do Not Disturb the user turned on themselves is left alone.

key.name: focus-start
key.description: 24-hour local time. If later than focus-end, the period runs past midnight.

key.name: launcher-order
key.description: The order of the launcher's apps and folders as the user arranged them: desktop IDs and "folder:ID". Items not listed follow in the default order.
